Character sprites extracted from D.C.4 ~Da Capo 4~ Sweet Harmony.

Due to the large number of character sprites and expression variants,
the complete character sprite collection has been divided into five galleries.

This collection contains the character sprites reconstructed from the
original game assets, including the available expression and sprite variants.

This gallery is Part 3 of 5 and the final part of the collection.
